statement: An authenticated pgwire CALL BINDING $1 command carrying {schema_version, name, arguments} resolves the tenant-scoped durable call Binding through a CallBindingRouteResolver — failing closed not-invocable when the Binding is absent, ambiguous, or carries no declared statement — executes the Binding-declared partition-local SELECT across the resolved partitions via the existing QueryExecutor fan-out with per-partition bounds and no silent partition-failure drops, marshals each shard's bounded rows into typed call-cell list<row> batches (integer s64/real/text/null; unsafe integers fail closed budget-exhausted before marshalling), and invokes the ready Cell's run export per shard through the sole ServiceDispatcher → MessageRouter → runtime invocation owner path with the lagrange:cell/call-context host imports (bounded emit, call-bounded) wired in the WASI worker; emitted partials are published under the reduce lease coordination pattern, a replica holding the reduce lease invokes the artifact's reduce export over a complete fresh disjoint partial set, and exactly one atomically published final snapshot is visible to the caller; legacy {kind,name} call bindings remain valid-but-not-invocable, pushdown maps through the same world with empty-JSON arguments, no runtime invocation mechanism is added outside the existing owners, and no feature flag survives the landing.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
